annotations.title: Read a floor plan into a 3D model

description: Loads a floor plan from a public https link (PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 15 MB, one storey per sheet) into a project of the connected account and starts reading walls, openings and rooms into a measured model. Costs 6 points per storey from the account, as in the app; refuses with the reason when points or the free month have run out. Reading runs one to three minutes; check the result with vedutum_get_project. For a file on the person’s computer, give them the upload link from vedutum_get_project instead.

file_url.description: Direct https link to the plan file (not a preview page), e.g. a download link

hint.description: Optional note for the reading, e.g. "the overall width is 12.40 m"

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

overall_depth_m.description: Overall outer depth of the building in metres, if known

overall_width_m.description: Overall outer width of the building in metres, if known. Not used for the reading: it is compared with the result, and a mismatch shows up in the review

project_id.description: Project id, as vedutum_list_projects returns it

read_anyway.description: Read the sheet as a floor plan although sheet_kind says it is none

sheet_kind.description: What the sheet shows, if known: floor (default), site, roof or section. Anything but a floor plan is not read and costs nothing, unless read_anyway is set

storey.description: Which storey the sheet shows: 0 ground floor (default), 1 first floor, -1 basement

name: vedutum_read_floor_plan
title: Read a floor plan into a 3D model
